messages:
Anita: Heads-up: I'm scheduling the users table dual-write + backfill tonight at 23:00 UTC. Need an owner for deploy, snapshot time for rollback, and someone to run smoke checks. Rollback dry-run prewritten? cc @Priya @Mike
Priya: I can take DB owner. I'll take snapshot at 22:45 UTC and verify. What's our estimate for backfill window and peak IO?
Mike: I'll be primary on deployment orchestration. Plan: 23:00 start dual-write flag, 23:15 start backfill for shards 0-2, 23:45 evaluate ramp. Rollback plan is in the runbook. @Sam can you run the smoke checklist at 23:05 and again after ramp?
Sam: Yup, I'll run smoke. Will validate user login, profile read/write, and feed fetch. I'll post a short checklist and results.
Jun: I'll be on-call fallback for the window. If anything looks wrong, call the pager. Confirm reachability.
Priya: DB snapshot command I plan to run:
```bash
pg_basebackup -h primary -D /snapshots/users_pre_migration -Ft -z
# then checksum: sha256sum /snapshots/users_pre_migration.tar.gz
```
I'll post the checksum here when done.
Anita: Also we should dry-run the rollback script against a staging snapshot earlier today. @Mike did the dry-run complete before 21:00?
Mike: Confirmed — I ran the rollback dry-run at 20:30 against staging. Logs: ops/snapshots/rollback-dryrun-2026-03-16.log. Script is idempotent; staging timing ~12m. No unexpected schema drift.
deploy-bot: Deploy slot locked by @Anita for 23:00 UTC. Runbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/users-dualwrite-backfill. Reminder: set traffic-control flag `users.migration.active=true`.
Sam: Smoke checklist I'll run:
- login via oauth
- create new user
- update profile picture
- fetch user feed
I'll paste pass/fail results.
Priya: Snapshot complete at 22:47 UTC. checksum: e3b0c44298fc1c14... (truncated).
Anita: Final go/no-go at 22:55 UTC. If no blockers, proceed. @Jun please confirm standby.
Jun: :thumbsup: Standby confirmed and reachable.
Mike: Note: backfill will run with throttling at 100 reqs/s to avoid overload. Backfill command we will use:
```python
python backfill.py --table users --shard 0-9 --rate 100
```
Sam: I'll run first smoke at 23:05 and post results.
Sam: 23:06 smoke: login ok, create user ok, profile update ok, feed fetch 200 OK. No errors.
Anita: Deploy started at 23:00. Enabling dual-write flag now.
Priya: Dual-write enabled at DB-level and confirmed write fanout. Observability counters look healthy.
Mike: Backfill started at 23:15 for shards 0-2. Monitoring CPU and p99 latency.
Sam: 23:50 smoke after ramp: all checks ok, no user-facing errors, p99 latency within target.
Anita: Rolling canary to additional shards at 00:05 UTC.
Jun: Observed spike at 00:07, rollback threshold hit: auth service p99 > 300ms. Mike — you want to rollback canary or throttle backfill?
Mike: Throttle backfill to 50 reqs/s and hold canary expansion. Priya please pause backfill for shards 3-5 while we observe.
Priya: Paused shards 3-5 at 00:09. No need for immediate DB rollback; dual-write still active so writes are safe.
Anita: Decision: hold and observe for 15 minutes. If not improving, we will rollback canary. Updating runbook status now.
Sam: I'll run an extra smoke check in 10 minutes and report metrics.
Sam: 00:18 smoke: latency improved to baseline after throttle. Auth p99 back under threshold. No rollback required. :relieved:
Anita: Thanks everyone. We'll finish the backfill overnight with throttling and confirm full completion tomorrow 08:00 UTC. Post final ops note when complete and then close.
Mike: I'll update the ops ticket and mark the rollback drill as exercised and complete.
